# TokenHunt

> Hook-based secret scanner for AI coding agents. token-hunt catches credential leaks at chat time — when you paste, when your agent reads, and when its tools return — instead of at commit time, after the secret is already in the transcript.

TokenHunt (PyPI: `token-hunt`, install: `pip install token-hunt`) runs as hooks inside agent platforms like Claude Code. Six hooks cover every entry point a secret can take into a transcript: UserPromptSubmit (your paste, WARN), PreToolUse:Bash (BLOCK), PostToolUse:Bash (WARN + log), PostToolUse:Read (WARN + log), PreToolUse:Edit/Write (BLOCK), and PostToolUse:Edit/Write (WARN + log). BLOCK hooks fail closed — the tool call is stopped before it runs. Findings print with rule, line, and a rotation URL. 48 credential rules across 53 provider families. CLI: `token-hunt scan <path>`, `list`, `close`, `watch`. Pattern layering and an allowlist for test fixtures are supported. Zero cloud, zero telemetry — everything runs locally.
